reply.text:
That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on what the wrist is or how long it should take to settle. Soreness that hangs around or gets worse is worth having looked at properly.

What I can do is build the training around it. Tell me what to avoid and I'll keep heavy push-ups and front squats out of today's work, and I'll work the rest of the session around that. If you want to be sure, check with a doctor or physio before you load anything through the wrist.
